objective: Build the signed-knot engine and the slow loop, tune the slow loop's policy on rand 2.1 and block 2.5 at n = 800, and test with five runs per instance on rand 2.1, block 2.5, local window 10 and local window 40 at n = 3200 (and the held-out patterns at 800) against re-tuned Novelty+ and probSAT, static probing, random targets, untangle only, an oracle-tuned policy and CaDiCaL.
status: No charged win for the transferred slow loop by the frozen rule (reading 4): G, its policy tuned on rand 2.1 and block 2.5 (the grid's laziest, slow budget 3% of the fast work), is at parity with re-tuned Novelty+ in all 10 cells (0.84 [0.65, 1.07] on local window 10 at n = 3200). The oracle-tuned eager loop GO has charged wins on both local patterns at 3200 (0.15 and 0.23, the second held out; 0.12 at 12800) and loses 1.5-2.1x on rand and block. The search's attention picks no better targets than random knots; shadow knots turned no cell into a win. Computed, referee pending.
title: Guided structure mutation (untangle and braid) between epochs of a fast search, against the fast search alone, static probing and CaDiCaL
